metas.name: I'm pregnant, it's not yours
metas.description: Husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.

metas.name: Beneath Her Gown: The Master's Claimed Wolf Pet
metas.description: Beneath Her Gown: The Master's Claimed Wolf Pet

metas.name: Disciplined by My Mafia Master
metas.description: Disciplined by My Mafia Master

metas.name: The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice
metas.description: New short drama 'The Hidden Dragon Rider Returns for Justice' coming soon, please look forward to it.

metas.name: The Gambling God Vanished Until the Final Hand
metas.description: With his parents butchered by a gambling syndicate, Peter Gumbel trains under the Gambling God and returns as an unassuming casino waiter. As he defeats one gambling master after another, he protects his loved one's casino, uncovers the truth behind his family's tragedy, and wagers everything for the ultimate revenge.

metas.name: OMG! My Divorce Client Is My Billionaire Husband
metas.description: Zoe and Alex met behind masks at a costume party and got married contractrally. Three years later, they cross paths again as strangers. Alex hires Zoe, now a lawyer, to end that marrige, without realizing he's fallen for the very wife he is trying to divorce.

metas.name: One Move God Mode 2
metas.description: One Move God Mode 2

metas.name: Daddy Don's Forbidden Pet
metas.description: After her parents' death, Sienna is forced to accept her stepfather's brother — the ruthless arms dealer Kian Voss — as her guardian. Desperate to escape, she follows him into a secret SM club, only to be masked and delivered into his private room. Her plan to expose him spirals into dangerous, addictive desire...

metas.name: The 100th Divorce Was Final
metas.description: After three secret years of humiliation, Deanna finally accepts Elton’s 100th demand for divorce. Only then does he learn she was the one who saved him from the fire years ago. Too late. Deanna has already married billionaire heir Jacob—and she’s never coming back.

metas.name: From XL to Extra Love
metas.description: Kate Harris, once an overlooked, plus-size dreamer, lands a job at Reynolds Group and meets the CEO of her fantasies—the effortlessly charming Lucas Reynolds. But her fairytale crashes when she’s framed for plagiarism by the jealous office queen Chloe, and Lucas, deceived by appearances, fires her on the spot. Crushed but not defeated, Kate takes a dangerous weight-loss drug and reemerges with a new identity and a stunning transformation.

metas.name: The Christmas Twin Miracle
metas.description: After losing her newborn twins on Christmas Day, Beth rebuilds her life—until she meets Ethan, a powerful CEO and single father whose twins claim she’s their mother. A marriage of convenience turns real, but when Ethan’s hidden identity and ex-wife resurface, love is pushed to the breaking point.

metas.name: QB! Look what you made me do!
metas.description: To cover her grandmother's sky-high medical costs, Nadia crashes a wedding as a faux mistress, escaping in rugby star Benjamin's jersey and unleashing a viral scandal over his inadvertent "cross-dressing" photo. Bound by a forced contractual marriage, she becomes a pawn for idol Paris, tasked with stealing Benjamin's playbook—a betrayal that plunges her into a moral quagmire.

metas.name: Script? Dead. Fate? Mine.
metas.description: Grace Chin wakes up as Lillian Quinn—the villainess of her own novel. Adopted for her rare blood to save the Quinns' heir, Lillian's fate twists when Sylvia, the real daughter and also a transmigrator whose inner thoughts can be heard by her family, returns. Can Grace rewrite Lillian's doomed ending?

metas.name: King of Underworld
metas.description: Wayne, secretly the invincible Hades, cures his wife Wendy's paralysis. But when elites demand she marry the ruthless Zane heir for profit, Wayne must unleash his true power. Surrounded by deadly conspiracies and a fake Hades, can the true King protect his love before rival families destroy everything?

metas.name: The Heiress Returns: Ex, Stay Away
metas.description: Bai Xiaoxi and Han Xingshen agree to a one-year marriage, believing that she can win his heart, only to receive a divorce agreement instead. Han Xingshen is unaware that the first love he has been searching for all along is Bai Xiaoxi, whose identity was replaced by Xia Zhi. Bai Xiaoxi arranges to meet Han Xingshen at a place where they once shared hardships as children, but she ends up in a car accident. During her rescue, she sees Han Xingshen being intimate with Xia Zhi, and feeling heartbroken, she signs the divorce agreement. Later, it is revealed that Bai Xiaoxi is the daughter of the wealthiest family in Jin City, and she loses her memory due to the accident. Bai Xiaoxi begins a new life, while Han Xingshen starts searching for her. The two reunite at a banquet, where their misunderstandings deepen. Xia Zhi slanders her, but Bai Xiaoxi publicly counters her. Bai Xiaoxi then showcases her talents at work, fighting back against workplace bullying...

metas.name: Fortune's Darling: The Lost Heiress Returns
metas.description: The Gale family brings Candice Gale back from an orphanage, but mistreats her while favoring their adopted daughter. By chance, Simon Smith, the richest man in the city, takes Candice in after she saves him once. Candice brings good fortune to the Smith household. With her around, Simon's wife wakes up from her coma, and they even find their missing son. In the end, it turns out Candice is actually Simon's daughter. The Smith family is finally reunited.

metas.name: Rebirth of the Billionaire Heiress: Return to the Mansion
metas.description: After Zhixia was reborn, she became a billionaire and asked her ex-boyfriend to polish her shoes. She was severely humiliated. It was so enjoyable.

metas.name: The Getaway Heiress Returns
metas.description: Her childhood was stolen, will her entire life be stolen too?Alice was originally the heir of the Damon family,but was kidnapped and abandoned by her uncle,who wanted the family fortune to himself. Alice was then adopted by Lisa. After becoming an adult, Alice ran into her biological parents again,but she's already lost her childhood memories.

metas.name: Godfather: Out of Control
metas.description: Godfather: Out of Control

metas.name: Queen Strikes: Traitor's Fall
metas.description: Chloe, CEO of California’s top hotel chain, sponsors poor student Elias and later marries him. On their 10th anniversary, she plans to hand him the company—but a mistress’s video exposes his long-time affair. Chloe confronts him at a hotel branch, only to face humiliation. As Elias arrives, the truth is about to explode.
